Worse for oversight: the ledger holds no routine fire line after 2026-11-01 12:13Z (the campaign routine's 3-hourly stand-down notes simply stop, and nothing from radar since 2026-10-30), so either those routines were disabled on claude.ai or they stopped firing; this digest cannot tell which and names it rather than assuming. Click queue: the live artifact (version 1792892782-ed70, published 2026-10-25, not attributable to a repo build) still holds the same three entries I drained with NOTEs last Saturday and never executed, because the republish that would clear them was skipped: `run selection CAMP-20260901-01`, `run universe prediction-market-plumbing`, `run screen h5n1-panzootic`; they are duplicates, skipped, and the edits block is empty. One new indicator trip (17 on file, was 16): minor-nsr-permits S4, CAT at 613.62 on 2026-11-02 against a 650 level (tripped 2026-11-03), 12% above its 52-week low of 546.13. Price files are fresh again after last week's 8-day staleness, and they moved the book: ACM, the one INVESTABLE name, closed 66.72 on 2026-11-05 and 66.725 on 11-06, inside its 61.00 to 71.00 zone and 9% over the floor, up from 62.27; WST reached 408.78 on 2026-11-04 near its 416.67 high and 2.5 times its would-buy zone, review overdue since 2026-10-30; GD (review overdue since 2026-10-30) at 373.46 on 11-02 against a 205.56 to 247.38 zone; AON (review_by 2026-11-06, now due) at 344.40 on 11-05 and a 381.26 high; BDX at 213.55 is a new 52-week high. The methanol shipyards have no new print since 2026-10-30 (Hanwha 50,000 and HD Korea 231,500, both 52-week lows), and Vopak ticked up to 53.15. Hard date: the China rare-earth export-control suspension expires 2026-11-10, 3 days out; its card SIG-20260901-02 is 47 days past review_by (2026-09-21) and SIG-20260828-02 (Tibet mega-dam) 23 days past (2026-10-15). The IMO vote of 2026-10-01 is still unswept (EVT-20260901-01 WATCHING). CAT's review_by of 2026-11-04 passed. Feeds: 19 of 20 sources ok, Federal Reserve press releases failing again. Shadow book: 81 rows, none graded, none due (earliest review_at 2026-11-26). Deferred backlog 126 OPEN, unchanged.
